verdict.rationale: Better Auth's docs say it supports multiple social providers (Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord, and more), and its SSO plugin covers OIDC, OAuth2 and SAML 2.0. Community users report using OAuth providers and various sign-in options without writing special code, which supports the configuration-driven claim. Missing for 10: a documented configuration snippet for enabling social providers, an enumerated list or count showing how broad provider coverage is, and documentation of generic/custom OAuth provider configuration.
